players.product: MBE-grown InP PIN / APD photodetector epiwafers for 100G-200G data-center optical transceivers, plus GaAs VCSEL / pHEMT and InP HBT epiwafers

quarterly_data.signal: Other lines (deck, operating strategy): GaSb - substrate prices raised in a first round on higher raw-material costs with a second round under way; orders from major defense customers are produced under contract and mass-production orders are hoped for in 2027; talks with major companies on non-defense GaSb infrared epiwafers. Hardware components - a new custom new-material MBE system moved from lease to purchase, with a buy-and-host model under discussion with major semiconductor equipment makers and a contract expected to be signed this quarter / year (as the deck puts it). GaN - GaN regrowth is gradually moving to volume orders, with a local Taiwan production-and-delivery model running.
